name: Texas Uniform Admission Policy (Top 10% Rule)
description: Guarantees admission to all Texas public universities (except UT Austin) for Texas high school seniors graduating in the top 10% of their class.

criteria.label: Texas Resident attending accredited Texas High School
criteria.fix: Student must graduate from an accredited high school in Texas or qualify as a Texas resident.

criteria.label: Class rank in the Top 10.0%
criteria.fix: Raise class rank into the top 10% of your graduating class (weighted GPA cutoffs determined by your high school).

criteria.label: Distinguished Level of Achievement Diploma OR SAT/ACT Benchmark

subcriteria.label: Distinguished Level of Achievement (4 Math incl. Algebra II, 4 Science, 1 Endorsement)
SAT Readiness Benchmark: 480 Reading/Writing AND 530 Math
ACT Readiness Benchmark: 18 English, 22 Reading, 22 Math, 23 Science

criteria.fix: Complete 4 Math credits (including Algebra II) + 4 Science credits + an Endorsement, OR meet SAT college readiness benchmarks (480 ERW + 530 Math).

name: UT Austin Automatic Admission Cap
description: Under Texas law allowing UT Austin to cap automatic admits to 75% of incoming in-state freshmen, UT Austin sets an individual cutoff (Top 6% for 2024–2026; moving to Top 5% for Fall 2027 entry).

criteria.label: Texas Resident attending accredited Texas High School
criteria.fix: Student must graduate from an accredited high school in Texas.

criteria.label: Class rank in Top 6.0% (Current) / Top 5.0% (Class of 2027+)
criteria.fix: Raise class rank into the top 6.0% (or top 5.0% for fall 2027 onwards) of your high school class.

criteria.label: Distinguished Level of Achievement Curriculum
criteria.fix: Complete 4 math courses including Algebra II, 4 science courses, and earn an endorsement on your Foundation High School Program.

name: University of California: Eligibility in the Local Context (ELC)
statute: University of California Board of Regents Policy 2102
description: California residents who rank in the top 9% of their participating California high school graduating class or top 9% statewide are guaranteed admission to a UC campus with available space (typically UC Merced if not admitted to chosen campus).
applicable_universities: University of California (Guaranteed at least one campus with capacity)

criteria.label: California Resident attending participating California High School
criteria.fix: Must attend a participating California high school and meet California residency requirements.

criteria.label: Class rank in the Top 9.0%
criteria.fix: Reach the top 9% of your California high school class (based on UC-calculated GPA in 10th and 11th grade A-G courses).

criteria.label: Minimum 3.00 UC Unweighted A-G GPA
criteria.fix: Maintain at least a 3.00 GPA in certified A-G coursework with no grade below a C.

name: Florida Talented Twenty Program
description: Guarantees admission to at least one of the 12 State University System of Florida (SUS) institutions for students in the top 20% of their Florida public high school class who complete required college-prep coursework.
applicable_universities: State University System of Florida (12 Public Campuses)

criteria.label: Florida Resident at a Florida Public High School
criteria.fix: Must graduate from a Florida public high school.

criteria.label: Class rank in the Top 20.0%
criteria.fix: Achieve a class rank in the top 20% of your public high school class by the end of 7th semester.

criteria.label: Complete 18 core college-prep credits with no grade below C
criteria.fix: Complete 4 English, 4 Math (Algebra I & higher), 3 Natural Science, 3 Social Science, 2 World Languages, and 2 Electives without grades below C.
